This isn't just a wake-up call for Binance, but for any company using AI in sensitive environments. The takeaway? As AI becomes more integrated into our systems, our approach to security and governance needs to evolve. Companies, especially in APAC, must reassess how they manage AI tools. It's not just about having the latest technology, but ensuring robust governance to mitigate these advanced threats.
